_description: Default Shrinkwrap_SoftFit parameters per fit class. Defined in gdd-character-creation-pipeline.md §7.4. Per-asset metadata may override individual fields.

plate.rationale: Plate's sculpted silhouette must be preserved; preserve mode skips inside-body verts entirely. Tight rim mask + modest offset gives armor-thickness clearance.

mail.rationale: Mail drapes naturally and should conform to body curves more readily than plate. Conform mode pushes inside-body verts out.

cloth.rationale: Cloth conforms most readily; wider capture radius and softer gamma let it follow body proportions closely without aggressive snap.
